title: Daily run full repair after PR199
summary: This iteration repairs the post-PR199 daily publishing path after the 2026-07-02 run stopped at the page quality gate. It fixes Builder/X title avatar rendering, aligns the HNRSS fixed-source alias with the current source reset name, prevents false sparse-supply Builder degradation, and routes public audit/template wording through the AI editorial repair loop.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "public daily followups infer localized X avatars from avatar_url during clean build|publish quality accepts Hacker News Frontpage 100\+ as HNRSS Frontpage fixed source proof|quality status does not mark Builder selection degraded when all eligible filtered candidates were selected|quality review routes public-copy banned terms to editorial repair|AI repair contract rejects public-copy banned terms in replacement values" tests/unit.test.js

degraded_sections.message: Executed no-signal remains a degraded condition, not a hard publish blocker.

lessons.lesson: Builder/X title icons can be lost at the final renderer even when report data already contains inferred local avatar paths.
lessons.evidence: The page check failed on `source_icons_present`; the renderer now accepts safe local media paths for title icons and tracked reports regenerate with avatar images inside Builder/X card titles.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep title-icon regression coverage tied to the effective-interact renderer, not only the interaction input model.

lessons.lesson: Fixed-source proof must track source reset display aliases, or valid current sources become false degraded reasons.
lessons.evidence: `Hacker News Frontpage 100+` now satisfies the HNRSS global-media requirement through a unit-backed alias check.
lessons.recommended_action: When renaming source reset surfaces, update both quality-status requirements and replay tests in the same change.

lessons.lesson: Sparse candidate supply should not be treated as dropped selection when selection snapshots prove all eligible items were used.
lessons.evidence: Builder/X quality status now checks `eligible_candidates` and `eligible_after_filter` before adding selection degradation.
lessons.recommended_action: Use selection snapshots for minimum-count judgments whenever a lane can legitimately have fewer eligible candidates.

lessons.lesson: Public copy banned terms need to enter the AI repair path before publish, and dirty repair output must be rejected.
lessons.evidence: The quality loop now creates public editorial rewrite tasks for 2026-07-01+ banned audit/template wording and the repair contract rejects replacements that still contain those terms.
lessons.recommended_action: Rerun the daily path after this repair before publishing the 2026-07-02 report.

suggestions.issue: The old generated 2026-07-02 report still contains public-copy audit/template wording.
suggestions.evidence: Local quality-review replay routes those fields to public editorial rewrite tasks with the repaired code.
suggestions.suggestion: Rerun the daily automation or dry-run publish path on the repaired revision so the editorial repair loop rewrites the old generated copy before any real publish.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The report can progress past the icon gate without carrying reader-facing audit residue.
suggestions.promotion_path: Next daily-run validation before publish authorization.
validation_evidence: AI repair contract rejects dirty replacements

followups.action: Rerun the daily automation or publish dry-run on the repaired revision before any real publish.
Inspect the generated AI repair contract for public-copy banned wording after rerun and verify the page check remains green on desktop and mobile.
